storyCards.headline: Here Comes The Rain Again: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Eurythmics's "Here Comes The Rain Again" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Here Comes the Rain Again" is a song by British duo Eurythmics and the opening track from their third studio album, Touch (1983).

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.

Here Comes The Rain Again was released in 1984.

"Here Comes The Rain Again" by Eurythmics.

Chart story — peaked at #4 on the Hot 100.
